verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.pt: Louvai ao Senhor! Louvai a Deus no seu santuário; louvai-o no firmamento do seu poder!
verses.en_web: Praise Yah! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!
verses.en_bbe: Let the Lord be praised. Give praise to God in his holy place: give him praise in the heaven of his power.

verses.en: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.pt: Louvai-o pelos seus atos poderosos; louvai-o conforme a excelência da sua grandeza!
verses.en_web: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!
verses.en_bbe: Give him praise for his acts of power: give him praise in the measure of his great strength.

verses.en: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.pt: Louvai-o ao som de trombeta; louvai-o com saltério e com harpa!
verses.en_web: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
verses.en_bbe: Give him praise with the sound of the horn: give him praise with corded instruments of music.

verses.en: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
verses.pt: Louvai-o com adufe e com danças; louvai-o com instrumentos de cordas e com flauta!
verses.en_web: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!
verses.en_bbe: Give him praise with instruments of brass and in the dance: give him praise with horns and corded instruments.

verses.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
verses.pt: Louvai-o com címbalos sonoros; louvai-o com címbalos altissonantes!
verses.en_web: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!
verses.en_bbe: Give him praise with the loud brass: give him praise with the high-sounding brass.

verses.en: Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.pt: Tudo quanto tem fôlego louve ao Senhor. Louvai ao Senhor!
verses.en_web: Let everything that has breath praise Yah! Praise Yah!
verses.en_bbe: Let everything which has breath give praise to the Lord. Let the Lord be praised.
